items: PERFORMANCE.org Step 3 (cache _updateAllColHeaderCounts), cherry-picked from perf-steps-1-4 onto main directly (skipping Steps 1-2, which showed a real filter/sort regression on perf-steps-1-4 — see debug/NOTES.md): the per-column unique-value/multi-row header-count scan (O(rows x columns), the file's own documented worst case) now memoizes its result per <table> against a cheap O(rows) signature of the currently visible rows' data-mb-row-idx values, and skips the full recompute whenever that signature is unchanged since the last call. This makes syncCollapseButtonsWithColumnVisibility's column show/hide re-init and multi-table sub-table re-renders free when the visible row set hasn't actually changed. The one known call site that mutates cell CONTENT in place without changing which rows are visible — initReleaseEventsColumn()'s two post-population re-scans of initCollapsableColumns(), which fill previously-empty Release events/country/date cells — now explicitly calls the new _invalidateColHeaderCountsCache() first so those counts still refresh correctly instead of reading stale (pre-population) cached values.

items: PERFORMANCE.org Step 4 (openUniqDrop() per-open caching): the unique-values dropdown's 5 full tbody.rows scan passes (whole-cell value counts, flag-icon segment map, relationship-cell detection, relationship icon counts, inline CAA/EAA-thumbnail counts) now share Step 3's exact caching primitive — a per-(table, column) WeakMap cache keyed by a signature of the currently visible rows' data-mb-row-idx values, via the shared _visibleRowSetSignature() added in Step 3. Reopening the same column's dropdown with no filter/sort change in between skips straight past all 5 passes. Found and fixed one correctness gap while implementing: the "Cell structure" section's collapsed/expanded split is read from expandedCells (individually-toggled cells), not derivable from the visible-row signature, so a lone cell expand/collapse click would otherwise leave a reopened dropdown showing a stale split. Added _invalidateUniqDropDataCache(table, colIndex) and wired it into all 5 places expandedCells is mutated by user interaction (_applyCollapseState()'s two branches, ensureCollapseDelegate()'s three inline toggle branches). Also gated the roleTokenValueCounts Map (an 'Entity info - Role' feature main grew independently since the original branch work) behind the same cache and added it to the stored bundle, so it doesn't come back empty on a cache hit.

items: tests: added artist-events performance-comparison instrumentation — `tests/live/artist-events-interactions.spec.js` (global/column filter, sort both directions, header-badge sanity, uniq-dropdown cache-invalidation correctness), `tests/support/capture-interaction-perf.js` (median-of-5 timing for global filter/column filter/sort/uniq-dropdown cold-vs-warm-open, written per-branch to `tests/snapshots/artist-events/interaction-perf-<branch>.json` so `main` and a performance-focused branch can be compared side by side), and `tests/support/capture-snapshots.js` extended with `post-filter.html`/`post-sort.html` full-DOM regression snapshots for `artist-events` (catching a rendering regression a canonical filter/sort action could introduce that no single correctness assertion would catch). All three load via the newly-captured `tests/fixtures/saved-data/artist-events.json.gz` disk fixture (`tests/support/capture-fixture.js`, extended with an `artist-events` entry and `seedGmValues`/`renderTimeout` support) rather than a live 42-page fetch. Canonical filter/sort/uniq-drop targets shared across all three via new `tests/support/artistEventsFixture.js`, so they can't drift apart. New `waitForActualRowCount()` helper in `tests/support/filterSortAssertions.js` — a stronger completion signal than the existing status-text-based waits for an action that narrows a large single-table page then widens it back out (confirmed empirically that `#mb-filter-status-display`/`.mb-row-count-stat` both update before the tbody rebuild and the `#mb-render-heading` chunked-render overlay have actually finished catching up, on `artist-events`' 4174 rows). No `ShowAllEntityData.user.js` changes — pure test-infra additions, per this project's existing precedent for test-only commits.
